title: REPRISE Phase 5: improvement loop with a pre-specified stop rule and one final evaluation on unused data
request: User (2026-10-02): improve the performance further; stop once a large improvement is obtained; hades may be used freely.
state_at_registration: No Phase 5 score on real data exists. The engine was tested on synthetic streams only (code tests). Known dev1 numbers of the frozen method (Phase 4 tuning files): standalone near AUROC 93.13 / FPR95 29.21, far 96.82 / 16.03; x TINS near 93.05 / 29.65, far 97.20 / 14.47.

frozen_reference.name: REPRISE v5
frozen_reference.score: s0 x prod_views p_M x p_LP

data_roles.dev1: exploration and selection (any number of candidates; 5 support/calibration draws x 3 orders x {near, far}, the existing TINS scores)
data_roles.dev2: confirmation of a locked candidate only; never used to choose between candidates. At most 3 confirmation attempts in this phase; every attempt is reported.
data_roles.U1_U2: scored once in Phase 4. Not read before the Phase 5 lock. After the lock the locked method may be re-run on them as a descriptive, non-independent comparison (Phase 5 was motivated by Phase 4 results).
data_roles.U4: new unused bank, built only after the lock: 5 new ImageNet-1K class splits (100 held-out classes each, the Phase 4 sibling rule, seeds 20261003..20261007), held-out classes disjoint from the dev1/dev2 held-out classes; ImageNet train images never used in any earlier phase (dev1/dev2 samples, TINS shots, R5 draws, the Phase 4 pool, sealed images excluded by name and sha256); per split 20 ID images x 900 classes and 50 OOD images x 100 classes; 3 support/calibration draws x 3 orders = 45 streams, batch 256.
data_roles.openood_test: OpenOOD v1.5 ImageNet-1K test (5 orders): scored once with the locked method after the lock (6th use of the test split overall; the count is reported). No selection on it.
data_roles.sealed: OpenOOD test and ImageNet val images stay sealed until the lock (manifest guard).

candidate_families: LP solver: zero start (every node from 0), sweeps, graph (k_g, gamma, weight of non-mutual edges), multi-scale products
class-conditional reference for the propagated mass (support nodes of the nearest class)
class-resolved propagation (one channel per ID class) and propagated embeddings (static score of the diffused feature)
memory admission: LP-gated, gated by the view's own visual p-value, gated by the fused visual p-value of all views; read-outs of the intermediate sets
all-stream statistics without an entrance (stream-vs-support similarity contrast, all-stream memory score)
propagation from memory members as OOD seeds
feature geometry fitted on the support images only (centring, shrunk within-class whitening)
views: fused DINOv2 views, CLIP ViT-B/16 image features as an additional view, other frozen encoders (second stage, only if the first stage does not meet the stop rule)
combination: products (sums of log p) of the above read-outs with weights from a small grid
any other label-free read-out computed from the same inputs (support, calibration, stream so far); every explored variant is logged
constraints: training-free and label-free at test time (16 labelled images per class: 12 support, 4 calibration, unchanged)
scores are issued per batch and never revised; no future batch is used (prefix test in the code tests)
the engine never receives OOD labels; labels are used by the evaluation scripts only

selection_on_dev1.primary: standalone (s0 = 1) near FPR95, mean over the 5 draws (orders averaged)
constraints: x TINS near FPR95 not above the frozen x TINS value
selection_on_dev1.rule: among candidates meeting the constraints, the lowest primary value; a simpler candidate (fewer components) is preferred when within 0.3 points
selection_on_dev1.lock: the selected candidate (all parameters) is written to selection_lock_p5.json with its sha256 before dev2 is scored with it

large_improvement.definition: on dev2 (5 draws, orders averaged; paired differences to frozen REPRISE v5, t interval with 4 df): standalone near FPR95 difference <= -5.0 points with the upper end of the 95% interval below -3.0; x TINS near FPR95 difference <= -4.0; standalone far FPR95 difference <= +0.5
large_improvement.if_met: lock the method, run the final evaluation once (U4, then the OpenOOD test), report, and stop the loop
large_improvement.if_not_met: return to dev1 (other candidates; second stage: additional frozen encoders). After 3 unsuccessful dev2 attempts, report the best confirmed improvement and stop.

final_evaluation.U4_primary: F1: standalone near FPR95, locked method minus frozen REPRISE v5 (differences averaged within split over its 9 draw x order conditions -> 5 split values -> t 95% interval, df 4). F2: the same x TINS.
final_evaluation.U4_confirmation: the large improvement is confirmed on unused data when F1 <= -4.0 points and the upper end of its interval is below 0
U4_secondary: best minimal configuration (zeta) of Phase 4 as a second reference
final_evaluation.openood: near and far AUROC / FPR95 (x TINS and standalone), per data set, 5 orders; paired differences to the Phase 3 values of REPRISE v5 (descriptive)
final_evaluation.no_change_after: no parameter or rule change after U4 or the test split is scored; later analyses are labelled post hoc

guardrails: all runs, failures and reruns are kept under logs/ and failures/
the number of explored configurations is reported
dev2 attempts are counted and reported
synthetic data are used for code tests only
